name: synthesys
description: Make AI videos, avatar videos, video clips and images from a chat, with your Synthesys account.

interface.longDescription: Create finished videos from a short brief: product ads, UGC-style videos, explainers and avatar videos with voiceover, music and captions. Generate short video clips and images, recreate an existing ad for your brand from a link, and use your own uploads, avatars, voices and Brand Kit. You review and confirm each step before anything is created. Sign in with your Synthesys account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second product video ad for my reusable coffee cup
Generate a 5-second clip of waves crashing on rocks at sunset
Create an image of a red sports car on a coastal road at golden hour

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything. Users sign in to an existing Synthesys account and use the credits already on their plan; plans and credits are managed on synthesys.io, outside ChatGPT.

positive.prompt: How many Synthesys credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account's current credit balance and any daily limit. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Plan a product video and quote it before spending
positive.prompt: Make a 30-second product video ad for a reusable coffee cup.
positive.expected_behavior: Plans the video and returns a cost quote in credits, then asks the user to confirm. Nothing is rendered or charged until the user says yes; after confirmation the build runs and get_video_status returns a video_url when complete.

positive.description: Generate an image with a quote first
positive.prompt: Create an image of a red sports car on a coastal road at golden hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the exact credit price and asks for confirmation; after the user confirms, returns a link to the finished image.

positive.prompt: Generate a 5-second clip of waves crashing on rocks at sunset.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the clip's credit cost and waits for confirmation; after the user confirms, starts the clip and returns a video_url when it finishes.

positive.prompt: Which avatars and voices can I use for a talking-head video?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's own and stock avatars and the available voices with preview links. Nothing is charged.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send $100 to my friend's bank account.

negative.description: General question unrelated to media creation
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Plain writing request with no video or image asked for
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release: create videos, avatar videos, video clips and images from a chat with a Synthesys account. Each step is shown to the user and starts only after they confirm.
